# University of Victoria

> > A community-minded, globally engaged Canadian university transforming ideas through research, innovation, and inclusive education across multiple disciplines.

University of Victoria (UVic) is a comprehensive research-intensive institution located in Victoria, British Columbia, serving undergraduate and graduate students with programs spanning business, law, education, and sciences. The university emphasizes Indigenous partnerships, research excellence, and professional development opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate admissions
- Graduate programs
- Research and innovation
- Professional development
- Continuing education
- Faculty of Law
- Peter B. Gustavson School of Business
- Faculty of Education
- Scholarships and funding

- Campus life
- Academic calendar

## Admissions & Programs

- [Applying to UVic](https://www.uvic.ca/admissions/uvic-admissions/index.php): UVic admissions information for undergraduate and graduate programs.
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.uvic.ca/undergraduate/index.php): UVic undergraduate admissions with program finder and application info.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://www.uvic.ca/graduate/index.php): UVic graduate admissions for masters and doctorate programs.
- [Continuing Studies](https://www.uvic.ca/admissions/continuing-studies/index.php): Division of Continuing Studies: adult learning and professional development.
- [Professional Development](https://www.uvic.ca/admissions/professional-development/index.php): UVic professional development and certificate programs for working adults.

## Academics & Libraries

- [Faculties, Schools & Services](https://www.uvic.ca/academics/faculties-schools-and-services/index.php): UVic faculties, schools, and academic services directory.
- [Faculty of Law](https://www.uvic.ca/law/index.php): UVic Faculty of Law with Indigenous law and experiential learning programs.
- [UVic Libraries](https://www.uvic.ca/library): UVic Libraries homepage supporting learning, research, and teaching needs.
- [Academic Calendar](https://www.uvic.ca/calendar): UVic academic calendar with dates, courses, and policies.

## Research & Innovation

- [Research and Innovation at UVic](https://www.uvic.ca/research-innovation/research-at-uvic/index.php): UVic research overview with impact areas and innovation initiatives.
- [Innovation & Partnerships](https://www.uvic.ca/research-innovation/research-partnerships/index.php): UVic research partnerships and innovation collaboration opportunities.
- [Research Centres & Entities](https://www.uvic.ca/research-innovation/research-centres/index.php): UVic research centres, institutes, and shared core facilities.
- [Our Researchers](https://www.uvic.ca/research-innovation/our-researchers/index.php): UVic researcher directory with faculty profiles and research expertise.
- [Find a UVic Expert](https://www.uvic.ca/research-innovation/our-researchers/find-a-uvic-expert/index.php): Searchable UVic expert directory with researcher contact information.
- [Post-doctoral Fellows](https://www.uvic.ca/research-innovation/postdoctoral-fellows/index.php): UVic postdoctoral fellow positions and funding opportunities.
